requirements.text: The system shall ensure all financial transactions are recorded accurately to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure data integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall maintain a comprehensive audit trail of all transactions for accountability and compliance.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage faults during transaction processing.
The system shall support safe degradation, ensuring access to essential functionalities during partial outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss in case of failure.
The system shall ensure all financial transactions are processed within 2 seconds to optimize responsiveness.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall generate financial reports in a performant manner while maintaining compliance and thoroughness.
The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency.
The system shall ensure that currency conversion operations complete within 3 seconds for real-time transactions.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing through efficient algorithms.
The system shall implement cloud-based solutions to reduce the carbon footprint associated with operations.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage significantly.
The system shall track the lifecycle resource impact of accounting features to identify areas for improvement.
The system shall provide users with sustainability reports showing energy and resource consumption metrics.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on roles.
The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious data entry.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The system shall implement user access controls to ensure only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall support multi-currency transactions with transparent exchange rates.
